answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, unlocked only after continuous uptime, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The juniper lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the zenith is where a second reviewer recomputes them. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the bridge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
